cited.quote: From March 2017 onwards only one Dal i.e. Tur Dal / Canadian Yellow Lentil and Palmolein Oil

rationale: C2 is the GO of 2021-12-03 extending the special PDS; it says only one dal (Tur Dal) is supplied and continues that arrangement, with no restoration of urad dal. C4 lists urad dhall only in a one-off Covid grocery kit, not the discontinued scheme. No official step to reintroduce it.

cited.quote: new working women hostels were constructed at three places in Tiruchirappalli, Guduvanchery and Tambaram

rationale: C2 and C3 show new hostels built at three places and Phase 2 at three more, with seven existing hostels retrofitted and functional since 13.07.2023. Thozhi hostels cover only 9 to 11 districts, so not all districts. Only a partial delivery; the date is the earliest operational date written in the extracts.

cited.quote: Immediate steps will be taken to disburse milk cost payment dues to milk

rationale: The extracts are dairy policy notes on Aavin operations, administrative reforms and milk-cost payments. None mentions a Commission of Aavin, Secretaries and producers to regulate procurement and distribution prices, or any GO or bill creating one.

cited.quote: Releasing Tamil Nadu’s Industrial Development Strategy for a five year period

rationale: C1 and C5 are the 2023 City Gas Distribution policy, a narrow natural-gas distribution policy rather than a diversified industrial growth policy based on natural resources. C3 only lists a planned industrial strategy; C2 and C4 are general. No GO adopting the indicated policy is shown.

No extract concerns opposing privatisation of railways. C4 and C5 are highway and road-over-bridge GOs, C3 is about elephant collisions on rail tracks, and C1 and C2 are about Mekedatu and finance. Nothing relates to the commitment.
None of the extracts concerns the appointment of trained archagars. They deal with ex-servicemen welfare, survey training and education advances, none relating to this commitment.

No extract is about electricity for ration cardholders in the Nilgiris. C1 is a general energy policy note, C2 concerns weavers' free electricity, C3 and C5 a wind repowering policy, C4 PDS computerisation. None addresses the commitment.

cited.quote: 5 Medicine Books were published at CIBF on 18.01.2023
The teachings of Periyar have been translated into 21 languages

rationale: C3 and C4 show the Thisaidhorum Dravidam scheme translating Tamil works into English and other languages and the Muthamizh Arignar scheme translating books into Tamil, with many titles published. The earliest dated release in the extracts is 18.01.2023 (C3); earlier launch dates are not given, so the date is approximate.

No extract concerns a Madurai-Theni-Bodi broad gauge line. C3 covers a Madurai-Thoothukudi line and Chennai suburban lines, C4 lists Theni village roads, and the rest are about Chennai metro. None is about the commitment.

cited.quote: It is necessary to improve the Ghat section to facilitate visits of tourists from all over India and abroad

rationale: The extracts concern Kodaikanal tourism (boat houses, carrying-capacity study, ghat road DPR) but none mentions a ropeway in Kodaikanal or Pazhani. Only related tourism activity is shown, no step for the ropeway.

cited.quote: Government have formed of Tamil Nadu Linguistic Minorities Social and Economic Development Corporation (TALMEDCO) in the year

rationale: C3 shows a corporation for socio-economic development of linguistic minorities, and C5 reserves linguistic-minority medical seats. Neither is a step to let linguistic-minority school students learn their mother tongue. Related activity only.

cited.quote: to ensure that Eelam Tamils have equal civil and political rights

rationale: C1 is a Governor's address stating the government will urge the Union to advise Sri Lanka on Eelam Tamils' rights. That is a statement of intent about Sri Lanka, not an appeal to the United Nations. No Assembly resolution, letter or GO on a UN appeal appears.

No extract concerns 50-bed speciality hospitals for beedi workers. C5 is licence forms for beedi establishments, C1 mobile labour health clinics, and the others general hospital matters. None addresses the commitment.

cited.quote: 6% interest subsidy is being reimbursed by the Government on the rates charged by District Central

rationale: C1 to C4 show only the existing 6% interest subsidy scheme, which C3 says was reintroduced in 2008 and continues. No extract shows a cut of rates from 12 percent to 8 percent for handloom cooperative societies. The same scheme carrying on is not a new step.

cited.quote: The trial run for the project had commenced on 20.02.2023

rationale: C1 reports the Athikadavu-Avinashi scheme at 99% completion, with a trial run from 20.02.2023 and water reaching all 1045 tanks and ponds, and inauguration planned. For a directional commitment this is a dedicated official measure, though no new GO is shown and the scheme was not yet inaugurated.

cited.quote: The erosion along the shore is mitigated by constructing bait arches, groynes and training walls

rationale: C2 says shore protection works with bait arches and groynes are being carried out, and C3 describes a coastal protection component of TN SHORE for 2024-2029. These show works under way but no dated GO or completed barriers coast-wide. Not yet operational across the coast.

cited.quote: Receiving and examining petitions requesting inclusion in the Backward Classes (BC) / Most Backward Classes (MBC) lists

rationale: C2 describes the Backward Classes Commission's general terms of reference, including petitions for inclusion in BC/MBC lists. No extract mentions the Viswakarma request or a decision on it. C4 and C5 concern Vanniakula Kshatriya reservation, a different group.

cited.quote: 350 Nos. of OBMs have been given to fishermen of Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli and Kanniyakumari
During the year 2022-23, under State scheme, 333 OBMs have been supplied to Kanniyakumari District fishermen

rationale: C1 and C4 show OBMs supplied under a subsidised state scheme to the three districts, but only 350 in 2023-24 and 333 for Kanniyakumari in 2022-23, well below 750 per year. Scheme operates with materially reduced numbers. The year is only approximate (2022-23 in C4).

cited.quote: Special Courts in the cadre of District Judge are functioning at the following 19 districts

rationale: C1 to C3 describe POCSO special courts and Mahila fast track courts, and C4 and C5 a negotiable instruments fast track court and an NDPS special court. None is for child trafficking trials. Related court activity only, no child trafficking step.

cited.quote: creation of infrastructure in the Village Panchayats like Schools, AWCs, Village Haats, Food Grain Godowns

rationale: C2 only says the focus is on creating infrastructure including Food Grain Godowns in village panchayats; this is a general statement, not a GO, tender or sanction for grain warehouses in each panchayat union. C1 and C5 are AGAMT-II guidelines without godowns.
